name: Risk-on macro + calm VIX dual gate arms BB-z washout reversion (BTC/ETH)
rationale: THESIS: a deep Bollinger z-score washout (bb_z far below band) only mean-reverts cleanly when the macro tide is IN and equity vol is calm; in a risk-off / high-vol tape the same washout is the start of a real breakdown, not a snap-back. DUAL REGIME GATE: macro_regime above its fitted risk-on level AND vix_level below a fitted non-extreme ceiling arm the entry; the bb_z floor is the mean-reversion trigger. Restrict focus to the deepest, most macro-coupled majors (BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT) where equity-vol beta is documented. Below HF capacity: long-only daily spot, no leverage. DISCONFIRMER 1 (is it just buy-the-washout?): the bare bb_z washout with the dual gate REMOVED is the bollinger-z-score-washout-reversion control already in the inbox; if gated deflated Sharpe is not materially above it, the regime gate adds nothing and it is plain band-reversion. DISCONFIRMER 2 (is the macro_regime the active ingredient or a level-in-disguise?): a sibling that flips macro_regime to lt (risk-OFF arming) on the same washout should be WORSE; if it is equal/better the composite carries no directional info. DISCONFIRMER 3 (holdout): purged+embargoed recent slice must stay positive or it is cycle-position-in-disguise.
catalyst: macro_regime risk-on AND vix_level calm coinciding with a deep bb_z washout in a major
